Deliverable 02 · Verb lab

Regular or irregular?

Regular verbs add -ed (post → posted). Irregular verbs change (write → wrote). Choose for each verb and see the past form.

Regular: + edIrregular: new word

The -ed sound

Listen. Which sound does the -ed make? /t/, /d/ or /ɪd/?

/t/ — worked

/d/ — called

/ɪd/ — posted

Tip: /ɪd/ only after t or d: posted, needed, wanted, decided.
